title: Draft
description: The fields whose Conversation tag and utterance-span binding an earlier turn of the same conversation established, held by the host for the gate between turns so that a later turn's proposal can carry them (GT-7). It is not an Affidavit and not a Docket entry: it has no entry id, status, decision or attestation, and nothing in it is sworn to. It is keyed by the tenant, the conversation and the tool, and holds exactly the fields whose tag in force is Conversation bound to an utterance-span that names its message.

tenantId.description: The tenant the draft belongs to; one part of the draft's key.

conversationId.description: The conversation the draft belongs to; one part of the draft's key.

toolName.description: The tool whose proposal the draft is for; one part of the draft's key.

fields.description: The drafted fields, one entry per field name; a later statement of the same name replaces the earlier (GT-7). A draft holds at least one field.

name.description: The field's name in the proposal.

value.description: The value as the proposal carried it.

tag.description: The Conversation tag the earlier turn minted, with its utterance-span binding, which names the message it was read from.

updatedAt.description: When the draft was last written.
